bullets.title: Nick Littlehales: the man who showed Cristiano Ronaldo how to sleep
Plackers twin-line dental floss
bullets.note: Let’s face it: most of us hate flossing, present company included. This floss was introduced to me by performance coach and PT [Kelly Starrett](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehq74v9/pnceh9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9iaWxpdHl3b2QuY29tLw==), and it makes getting in between teeth a breeze, lessening the likelihood of the saw-saw-pop-bleed mess. Combine with something like [a Sonicare toothbrush](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehq74v9/xksph6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudXNhLnBoaWxpcHMuY29tL2MtbS1wZS9lbGVjdHJpYy10b290aGJydXNoZXM=) and your dentist will have far less work to do.

bullets.title: Tristan Harris
bullets.note: for switching between grayscale and color.** I’ve previously recommended switching your iPhone to grayscale as a means of reducing social media use, based on [Tristan Harris](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehq74v9/60aeh8/aHR0cDovL3d3dy50cmlzdGFuaGFycmlzLmNvbS8=)’s recommendation via comedian [Whitney Cummings](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehq74v9/kmbmh6/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE1LzA2LzI2L3doaXRuZXktY3VtbWluZ3MvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==). It really works. Alas, the process involves many steps and is a pain in the ass. Fortunately, “The Crazy Bulgarian” (his requested name), introduced me to a great shortcut [via Lifehacker](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehq74v9/52hvh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9saWZlaGFja2VyLmNvbS9jaGFuZ2UteW91ci1zY3JlZW4tdG8tZ3JheXNjYWxlLXRvLWNvbWJhdC1waG9uZS1hZGRpY3RpLTE3OTU4MjE4NDM=), “To easily toggle between color and grayscale, go to Settings > General > Accessibility > Accessibility Shortcut > Color Filters. Now, you just press the home button three times to enable grayscale. Triple-click again to go back to color.”
